We never merge pull requests in this repository. It is a published copy of the site, and each publish replaces its files. A maintainer copies your change to the repository where we work on the site, with you as co-author. When the change is live, they close this pull request with a link to it.

Translations work differently. Fix them in [meshcore-europe/meshcore-info.eu_i18n](https://github.com/meshcore-europe/meshcore-info.eu_i18n): pull requests there are merged.

What does this change, and why?
